data.body: Operator decision 2026-09-07 (approved): keep the value-preserving re-spell of the six `.github/complexity-baseline.json` keys in this change. Landing instruction: push for review as its own change; when CI reports `Verified -1` with the `Complexity-baseline lock` step as the ONLY red item, the operator (an administrator) force-submits it, which is the override task 47e9 designed the lock with. The implementing agent must not perform the override; it reports the CI run and hands off. The commit message names the six keys, states that ceilings are unchanged, and cites this decision.
